thread:
maria_sales: Quick sync — ACME just asked to add streaming ingestion (webhook -> real-time embeddings) and bump peak to 200qps. Also added data residency + BYO-KMS. Need to align success criteria and cost/timeline.

alex_se: Got it. Current acceptance criteria was 50qps batch embeddings, gen p95 < 120ms, eval pass >85%. Original timeline 3 weeks.

ben_devops: Streaming + BYO-KMS is nontrivial: KMS egress, key wrapping, Private control plane changes. Ops estimate +2 weeks for infra + validation.

sam_research: For realtime embeddings at 200qps <100ms/embedding, model + batching matter. We can test int8 quantized embedder but expect slight quality drop — will run a side-by-side on their seed prompts.

irina_security: We need completed security questionnaire, SSO/IAM mapping, and to know if HSM is required. That will affect the schedule.

alex_se: Suggested compromise: split into Phase A (deliverable in 3w: batch flows + existing criteria) and Phase B (streaming + BYO-KMS + peak load) in +2–3w. Also offer a short Dedicated trial for peak capacity.

maria_sales: They want single-phase if possible. Can we demo streaming without full BYO-KMS to keep timeline?

ben_devops: We can provide a demo proxy KMS (Redwood-managed keys, regional residency enforced) as a demo-only option with customer risk acknowledgement — saves ~2 weeks. Also recommend demo at 100qps with graceful degradation.

sam_research: Propose Phase B demo at 100qps sustained, degrade to 200qps. We'll produce comparative eval: float16 vs int8 (cosine delta / MRR change).

maria_sales: Can someone draft updated acceptance criteria + short timeline? I present to the customer tomorrow.

alex_se: Draft acceptance criteria: Phase A (wk0–3): batch embeddings + rerank demo, gen p95 <120ms, embed median <50ms, quality >85%, Hosted API (no BYO-KMS). Phase B (wk4–6): streaming ingest demo 100qps (graceful to 200qps), BYO-KMS pilot or proxy (risk ack), 1-week Dedicated trial for peak capacity, comparative quality report.

ben_devops: Add operational acceptance: failover runbook and Dedicated trial cost estimate. Ops quick estimate: 200qps pool ~ $1.8k/day; reduced 100qps + proxy KMS ~ $700/day.

irina_security: Add security items: questionnaire, network rules, demo data retention window (recommend 7 days), and signed exception if they insist on non-HSM BYO-KMS for demo. I'll draft risk ack.

ops_bot: deploy-trial - scheduled - Dedicated trial request submitted for 2024-07-12 to 2024-07-19 (pending allocation).

sam_research: Running evals now — command I'll use: `python eval/compare_embeddings.py --model rwd-embed-1 --quantize int8 --input seeds.csv --out results.json`. Expect preliminary numbers by 18:00 PST.

sam_research: Preliminary: int8 cosine mean drop ~0.012 vs float16; rerank MRR drop ~1.5%. Details uploaded to the shared drive.

maria_sales: Perfect — I'll present Phase A as the immediate deliverable and Phase B as an opt-in paid trial with clear ROI + risk ack. @alex_se please drop the slide link here.

alex_se: Uploaded summary slide: https://drive.internal/rwd/poc-acme/streaming-proxy-kms-summary.pdf :thumbsup:

maria_sales: Meeting set for tomorrow 10am PT. Goal: sign Phase A today and get Phase B opt-in. Fingers crossed.

maria_sales: Thanks everyone — cc legal for the KMS risk ack and ops for the Dedicated cost worksheet.
